fin_assessment: Packaged smoke explicitly asserts request_fin and fin_count == 1 for each of two origin requests, together with exact request byte length/hash, ordered duplicate trailers, method, authority, certificate identity and exactly one request per path.

Origin request_fin is sourced from actual aioquic H3 HeadersReceived/DataReceived.stream_ended, not response success or a scheduled timer. fin_count counts the first observed completed request, guarded by finished; this is one logical request FIN observation, not a raw retransmission/event counter.

Origin echo final response is produced only after observed request completion; downstream H3 peer requires real H3 stream_ended, exact response bytes and ordered trailers. Finite deadlines, normal child exits and immediate listener/origin port rebind checks remain intact.
